verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a documented REST API (e.g. bulk issue mutation, events endpoints) and additionally ships an official MCP server and CLI explicitly for AI agent use, giving AI-native users multiple documented, programmatic ways to drive the product. However, no machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (all candidate paths 404), and no independent hands-on API integration report was cited. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger schema, independent third-party validation of API completeness.
